description: This file defines the 'OAuthAccessToken' entity class for managing OAuth 2.0 access tokens within the OrangeHRM system. It maps to the database table 'ohrm_oauth2_access_token' and includes properties like token ID, access token string, client ID, user ID, expiry date, and revoked status, along with respective getter and setter methods.

classes.name: OAuthAccessToken
classes.description: Entity class representing OAuth 2.0 access tokens with properties for token details, expiration, and revoked status, mapped to the database table 'ohrm_oauth2_access_token'.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the token's primary key ID.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the token's primary key ID.

methods.name: getClientId
methods.description: Returns the client ID associated with the token.

methods.name: setClientId
methods.description: Sets the client ID for the token.

methods.name: getUserId
methods.description: Returns the user ID associated with the token.

methods.name: setUserId
methods.description: Sets the user ID associated with the token.

methods.name: getExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Returns the token's expiry date and time as a DateTimeImmutable object in UTC timezone.

methods.name: setExpiryDateTime
methods.description: Sets the expiry date and time for the token.

methods.name: isRevoked
methods.description: Returns whether the token has been revoked.

methods.name: setRevoked
methods.description: Sets the revoked status of the token.
